title: The auto-mode allow list holds one entry for `merge --review-record` in lane sessions, so a lane posts its own review record
why: Owner ruling own-839-a-review-record-allow-entry (page item 839, option a, 14:59 CST Nov 14, no note): add one allow entry for `merge --review-record` in lane sessions. The pattern comes from the lane, and a guard review checks it (the review is the check on the pattern). Home of the change: settings.json autoMode.allow, by a lane through a draft PR, as in the earlier entries (own-759-b-label-allow-entry, own-786-c-base-red-ok-settings); triage edits no settings. The grant covers this one command form and no other. Why: the classifier denied `merge --review-record` five times in the #3407 lane (with `--guard no`, with `--guard yes`, for a round 1 PASS and a round 1 FAIL; the fifth right after a fresh reviewer PASS) while the same form was allowed in the lanes of #3158, #3402, #3400, #3405, #3409 and #3411; coordinator's account, unchecked by triage; floor of 5 denied and 11 allowed calls, rate unmeasured. The cause of the denials is unknown, so the entry may not stop them: the lane that builds it says in its report whether #3407's record posts after the entry, and if it does not, the item returns to the owner. First act of a lane: read the earlier entries and their guard check, write the narrowest pattern that names `merge --review-record` and nothing else, red then green on a test that a nearby form (another merge flag) is still not allowed. Round 3 applies: it widens a guard. Until it merges, #3407 waits: no other form is tried. LANE STARTED 15:01 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 15:10; create_session 15:01 CST; Sonnet, medium): lane session_013NEJL2u29a6GcaS5Q5KoEn. Brief: the grant's exact scope (only the `--review-record` form; no other merge form); the narrowest pattern; a red test that `--confirm`, `--ready` and `--lint-unknown-ok` forms stay refused; a `Departs from:` line with the exact pattern before the review rounds; round 3 applies (settings.json is a guard file). If the lane's own record post is denied, it sends the coordinator the verbatim refusal and tries no other shape. #3407 waits for this entry. PREMISE CORRECTED 15:11 CST Nov 14 (the lane's read via the coordinator 15:09; triage read none): main's bare `merge <pr> --review-record` is already allowed (entry "Merge Tool Read Checks"), so the page text for item 839, "main has no entry", was wrong for the bare form. The owner's a still holds: one new entry for lane sessions, flags named. Not blocking. The wrong line came from the coordinator's 11:48 CST report and was posted unchecked by triage (the item said so under Based on, "unchecked by triage", but its Departs from line stated it as fact). HANDED IN 15:57 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 15:56): #3424 handed in and given to runner 10; the coordinator read its head dde80a04da3e, files, record 6884638500 and lint 6884795372 by REST (net value zero, round 3 FAIL on red CI only, fixed by a rename-only commit with a fix check; triage read none). Deviation the coordinator accepted: no split lane for the red glossary lint, one rename-only commit plus a fix check instead (rule roles-review-cap-three, small fix to a round's finding). Notes left unfixed: glossary says "review log", prose says "review record"; text tests pin names, not meaning. MEASUREMENT NOTE 15:57 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 15:56, the lane's words relayed; triage read no code): bare `merge <pr> --review-record` without --head/--kind/--guard always parse-errors (merge.py around line 5039), so main's "Merge Tool Read Checks" never covered a working record call. The new entry may fix the classifier denials, or may not: cause unmeasured; the lane met no denial in its own 5 record calls. The next lane's record post after #3424 merges is the first measure. Move to done when #3424 merges (not yet merged).
